name: East Yaraq Outpost
title: East Yaraq Outpost
summary: Old starter outpost near Yaraq that Martine never attacked; new arrivals now portal straight into Yaraq (acpedia). In the kit it sits in a sand gully below a mesa: a green-lit three-storey Empyrean hall with tapered roof (0x010014C3, top 54.9), an octagon tower, a cottage, the Life Stone with its sign and a glowing red stone frame, and on the mesa top 120 m south-west a 31 m spire tower (top 110.8).

site.name: East Yaraq Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-yaraq-8164 (the outpost Life Stone, 21 m from the anchor).

shots.standingOrder: Jib up 14 m from 4 m above the sand 60 m north-east of the green-lit Empyrean hall, swinging 16 degrees as the spire tower on the mesa behind catches the low sun; keep 30 m from the Life Stone sign, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Crane at East Yaraq Outpost, the one starter outpost Martine never destroyed: rising from near the Life Stone, the green-lit Empyrean hall and, behind it, the spire tower on the mesa top (z 80-111) are backlit by the low golden sun for silhouettes and rim light.
